title: 第19章  她是吸兽人精气的妖精第20章  我想要
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
谢京墨走到她的身边，居高临下地看着她。
季欢被他盯得有些受不了，她低着眸子，不与他对视。
她真的后悔来这里了，这些人都好可怕。
而且，她怎么就没看到一个女人呢？
谢家老大和老二都结婚了的，可是家宴却不见他们的兽妻。
“季欢，离烬沉远一些，你们两个是不可能在一起的。”
季欢此时抬眸看向他。
“我知道，是他硬要我来的，我现在可以离开吗？”
季欢的眼睛很漂亮，又大又亮，清透干净。
谢京墨的眸色微沉，这样的她，很漂亮，并且很单纯，没有任何攻击性，让人很想保护。
谢京墨都有些动容了，想伸手摸一摸她的头，安抚她，说当然可以。
突然他眸子一厉，要不是他和她睡过，他都要被她装出来的单纯模样给骗了。
这个小雌性坏得很，在床上很主动，让他完全失控。
更别说烬沉了。
简直就是个吸兽人精气的妖精。
季欢心虚呀，所以面对谢京墨的时候，总是没底气。
很怕被他知道。
就在这时，谢烬沉进来了，他开心地坐到季欢的身边。
“姐姐，很快就吃晚餐了，吃了晚餐我们就可以走了。”
季欢看到他脸上有五个指印，他竟然还笑得出来。

他们都无视了谢京墨。
季欢抬手摸了一下他的脸。
谢烬沉痛得轻呼一声。
“嘶……”
“你被打了？”
季欢好笑，不过，这小子还挺可怜的，回来就被打，回家都有心理阴影了吧！
谢烬沉脸上的笑容一僵，他叹了一口气。
“因为我不够优秀，脑子又笨，所以被我父亲打了一巴掌。”
其实是他叫板他父亲，说他就要娶季欢为兽妻。
他父亲觉得他无理取闹，一巴掌挥了过来，他没躲，也没叫痛。
就这样与他父亲冷目相对，与他平时的样子很不同
他父亲都觉得这个小雌性有什么魅力？
竟然能让软弱的儿子变得如此钢。
季欢看他那可怜的模样，从空间拿出药，给他脸上上药。
“痛，你别碰！”
季欢冷声说：“我给你上药，你忍一下。”
content_en:
Xie Jingmo walked to her side and looked at her condescendingly.
Ji Huan couldn't stand being stared at by him. She lowered her eyes and didn't look at him.
She really regretted coming here, these people were so scary.
Moreover, why didn't she see a woman?
The eldest and second eldest son of the Xie family are both married, but their beast wives are missing from the family dinner.
"Ji Huan, stay away from Yan Chen. There is no way you two can be together."
Ji Huan raised his eyes and looked at him.
"I know he forced me to come. Can I leave now?"
Ji Huan's eyes are very beautiful, big, bright, clear and clean.
Xie Jingmo's eyes darkened slightly. She was very beautiful and innocent, without any aggression, making people want to protect her.
Xie Jingmo was a little moved and wanted to reach out and touch her head to comfort her and said of course.
Suddenly his eyes sharpened. If he hadn't slept with her before, he would have been deceived by her pretended innocence.
This little female is so mean and so proactive in bed that she loses control completely.
Not to mention the ember.
She is simply a goblin that sucks the energy of orcs.
Ji Huan felt guilty, so he always felt unsure when facing Xie Jingmo.
I'm afraid that he will find out.
At this moment, Xie Jinchen came in and sat down next to Ji Huan happily.
"Sister, dinner will be served soon. We can leave after dinner."
Ji Huan actually laughed when he saw five fingerprints on his face.
They all ignored Xie Jingmo.
Ji Huan raised his hand and touched his face.
Xie Jin let out a soft cry of pain.
"Hiss..."
"You were beaten?"
Ji Huan is funny, but this kid is quite pitiful. He was beaten when he came back, and he will have a psychological shadow when he returns home!
The smile on Xie Jinchen's face froze, and he sighed.
"Because I wasn't good enough and stupid, I was slapped by my father."
In fact, he was the one who challenged his father, saying that he would marry Ji Huan as his beast wife.
His father thought he was being unreasonable and slapped him, but he didn't hide or cry out in pain.
Just giving his father a cold look was very different from his usual appearance.
What does his father find attractive about this little female?
How could he make his weak son become so steely.
Ji Huan looked at his pitiful appearance, took out medicine from the space, and applied it to his face.
"It hurts, don't touch it!"
Ji Huan said coldly: "I will give you medicine, please bear with it."
